Barclays to Cut 5,000 Jobs Globally Amid AI Integration

Barclays plans to eliminate approximately 5,000 jobs worldwide by the end of 2026 as part of an efficiency drive that involves increased investment in artificial intelligence. This reduction represents about 5% of the bank's global workforce. The move is intended to optimize operations and enhance productivity, with AI playing a larger role in the bank's functions. Reports indicate that India's back offices may be significantly affected by these job cuts.
